t.zh: 质检台只能逐位置比较，无法利用周围读数区分细碎干扰和较大结构。这章要造邻域处理器，再把它装成扫描器。先从三个位置开始：取样位置与贡献权重分开，所有数值由电路计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The station compares individual locations but cannot use surrounding readings to separate fine nuisance from broader structure. Build a neighbourhood processor and then a scanner. Start with three positions: sample locations and contributions are separate; the circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 权重的位置、符号与总和分别影响方向、响应与增益。负权重和非单位增益也有用途。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Weight positions, signs and sum affect direction, response and gain. Negative weights and non-unit gain can be useful. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用给定的位置权重组合左、中、右三个读数。输出与输入同尺寸，图外取 0；权重不必总为正，也不自动归一化。
brief.en: Combine left, centre and right readings with the supplied positional weights. Keep image size, read zero outside, and do not automatically normalise or discard negative weights.

naiveWhy.zh: 位置权重跟随读取的位置；交换两侧会反转非对称规则。恒定图还会显示权重和造成的增益。
naiveWhy.en: Weights belong to positions. Swapping sides reverses an asymmetric rule; constants also expose the gain from the weight sum.

hint.zh: 亮点能显示谁贡献到哪个位置；先把三路分别接到输出观察，再组合。
hint.en: An impulse reveals which sample contributes where. Inspect the branches before combining them.

hint.zh: 常量图检验总增益，非对称权重检验方向；系统计算所有乘积与和。
hint.en: Constants test gain and asymmetric weights test direction; products and sums are automatic.

desc.zh: 沿所选空间轴，按前侧、中心、后侧权重汇合三格读数。横向对应左中右，纵向对应上中下；图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Combine three readings along the selected axis: left/centre/right for x, above/centre/below for y, with explicit borders.
